note: Clarification of unit-grid search completeness; immutable design and evidence unchanged.
axis_alignment: Any finite tiling of the connected rectilinear target by rectangles has a connected positive-edge contact graph. Along each contact, one side of each rectangle is parallel; their perpendicular companion sides therefore share the same two orientations. A rectangle on the outside boundary is axis aligned, which propagates through the graph.
integer_alignment: For axis-aligned bars with integer side lengths, a generic horizontal line starts at an integer-coordinate target boundary and crosses integer-width rectangles, so all crossed vertical edges have integer x. Applying the same argument vertically gives integer y. Hence each placement belongs to the enumerated grid placements.
B_obstruction: No horizontal or vertical run contains5 cells, so the1-by5 bar cannot be placed; all four other boards have saved exact-cover placements.
